title: Consumer-products e-commerce seller in Florida
assumptions: A Miami e-commerce seller of general consumer products that imports what it sells: answered the intake (doesn't manufacture, imports, no children's products). Customs filings, origin marking, the GCC and HTS as CBP's to decide, and other states' remote seller thresholds; Florida's own remote seller rule isn't stated for a Florida seller.
